name: Ordinal Number Fixation
effect: The altered model keeps dropping ordinal numbers (10th, 20th, 70th, 99th, 'tenth and eleventh hour') where they make no sense, swapping them in for names, dates and nouns. Sometimes it collapses into loops like 'the 10th of the 10th of the
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 39/40 held-out pairs. Near miss: judged alone, it failed only the strict specificity check.
